svg.title: General E/I network: shared and private inputs on the left, populations on the right
svg.desc: Shared external sources project through separate bold W superscript X to E and X to I matrices to excitatory E and inhibitory I populations. Independent private sources feed each neuron in each population. E is above I. All four recurrent pathways are included: E to E, E to I, I to E and I to I. Dark arrows indicate excitation; rose bars indicate inhibition. Within-population recurrence does not imply autapses. Shared sources have common rate r X, private sources have common rate r private. External conductances are stationary mean parameters; only the two rates and four recurrent conductances are dynamical states.
svg.text: Stationary shared and private input means → six recurrent states
Sources can reach both E and I
Input means are parameters · Within-population loops do not require autapses
